hooks.command: : 'codex-alpha-goal-compact-recovery:v1'; printf '%s\n' 'Compact recovery policy:' 'After compaction, before the next substantive action, decide whether one or more candidate skills below applies to the current task.' 'If a candidate applies, invoke and load that skill before acting; treat pre-compaction remembered skill text as stale.' 'For active Alpha Goal tasks, resume from goal-contract.md first; use checkpoint.md only when that conditional checkpoint exists.' 'If checkpoint Loop State phase is HARDENING or VERIFICATION, inspect checkpoint Verification/Evidence gap before acting.' 'If none applies, continue normally without loading these skills.' 'Candidate skills:' '- $alpha-goal: use for requirements, goal framing, design, scope, acceptance evidence, decision boundaries, and claim boundaries.' '- $control-loop: use for bounded implementation or hardening after an explicit goal specification.' '- $goal-verify: use for goal completion/readiness/review/audit verification, including evidence coverage, claim boundary, defect/risk sweep, and material unclaimed issues.'
hooks.statusMessage: Refreshing Alpha Goal compact recovery policy
